note: Stanislaus NF campground in timber near the shore of Spicer Reservoir, 9 mi SE of Hwy 4 on Spicer Reservoir Rd (7N01), a winding paved road where speeds average 20-30 mph. A boat launch is beside the campground; the lower lake has a 10 mph limit and the upper arm, by the Carson-Iceberg Wilderness, is for paddle craft only. Bears frequent the area. Run by Royal Elk Park Management. --Claude
